items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yes, and the De Marcos, and Benny Fields, and one of those Blossoms, Blossom Seals.

ctx.x: So, Lou Holtz took you back to New York to appear in “Star Time”?
Yes, and the De Marcos, and Benny Fields, and one of those Blossoms, Blossom Seals. So I learned about show business from them, the vaudeville stuff. ‘Cause they knew all that.
